title: FRAME ASSEMBLY
summary: Chassis frame assembly, all models: the complete frame [1] with its gage (locating) holes and dimensions used when the body is dropped onto it, plus the bolt-in member assembly [2] (crossmember at the rear kickup), held at each end by a bolt [4] with lock washer [3] driven up from below, 55-65 lb-ft.

parts.name: MEMBER ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Member assembly – crossmember (bolt-in, rear kickup area)

fastening.note: Bolt [4] goes up from below through lock washer [3] into the end of member [2] at the frame (one end shown, RH side).

notes: NOTE: At body drop use a .562 +.000/-.002 dia. pins at locations shown on L.H. & R.H. side.
Gage holes: R.H. GAGE HOLE, L.H. GAGE HOLE, GAGE HOLE A.
24.00 ±.03 (along the frame side rail, to the L.H. gage hole)
36.30 ±.03 (from gage hole A along the frame side rail)
notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch wipes out digits 4–6; '397' and final '0' visible (6th digit only a sliver, not read).
Item 2: 5th digit clipped by the hole punch (only its bottom curve visible); '3949', '87' clear.
Frame [1] is the base unit; it carries no fastening on this sheet (body mounting is elsewhere).
Which frame end is front is not labelled; member [2] read as at the rear kickup from the frame shape.
